newsitem.title: UK: Prices up for finer tops on Bradford wool market.
newsitem.headline: Prices up for finer tops on Bradford wool market.

text.p: Prices for finer tops were up on the back of global increases in merino prices despite the recent strength of sterling, sources in the Bradford wool market said on Thursday.
Values for 70s Super were quoted at 520 pence per kg, up seven pence in the week while 66s Super were up eight pence.
The pound has also had a dampening effect on exports while South Africa has emerged as a source of competition, joining European firms in undercutting UK prices, trade sources said.
Coarser tops prices were largely unchanged, they said.
